name: two-tower-llm-hard-negatives
intended_use: First-stage semantic candidate retrieval over the podcast episode catalog, replacing the pretrained-embedding ANN baseline if it beats it on the relevance set. Trained on LLM-written natural-language queries with mined hard negatives only (negative-strategy arm), distilled toward the pretrained encoder, checkpoint selected on judged-pool re-ranking; no transcripts (the training snapshot predates transcript excerpts); not for ranking or personalized retrieval.
